feature: Hardware abstraction boundaries + deterministic final build verification
release: Final verifier orchestration and build continuation repair
contracts: final verifier chain is executed by one Node.js orchestrator
verifier child output is inherited and each child exit status is checked explicitly
successful final verification transitions directly into the Theia production build
completed-build state is stamped only after the Theia build succeeds
checks: Build invokes CJS/Run-NovaOrynIDEFinalVerification.cjs rather than chaining the final verifiers directly in CMD.
The orchestrator runs the kernel preset, SDK test-framework and 0.14.13 release verifiers.
The orchestrator prints the exact verifier filename and exit code on failure.
A successful orchestrator return is followed by the Theia production build and final build-state stamp.
